## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 12, 2026 - Sep 15, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Hi A_, Sep 13, 2026, 1/5: "Disappointing UI, broken AI Messy Interface: hard to navigate and doesn't even let you choose preferred units (kg/lb), forcing every unit option on screen at once. Inaccurate Food Scanner: Logging 65g of meat showed up as 100g of fish. Three other 4.5+ star apps got it 100% right on the first try. Billing Issues: Charged my card after I already canceled the subscription. Save your money, PRO is a waste, actually the app is pointless there is soooo much better options. Run until you can"
            2. _John Rinehart_, Sep 15, 2026, 3/5: "great tool for tracking your daily habits and is fairly accurate considering these kinds of apps are notoriously unreliable I've used it to go into a calorie deficit for fat loss and recently changed goals to maintenance as I learn things about my own metabolism. the suggested macros and caloric intake has been pretty good. however there are some basic functions that are behind a paywall, a paywall that didn't exist 4 yrs ago. greed doesn't look good on anyone."
            3. _Cari Cruse_, Sep 13, 2026, 3/5: "Feature Request: It would be so helpful when scrolling down our Diary if the calories (& macros) were pinned at the top. Also, please make the selected day more obvious at the top, it's too easy to enter things on the wrong day. || Cancelled Premium! New UI is horrible mess. Have used MFP 13 years."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Sep 10, 2026 - Sep 10, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Natalie Kirk_, Sep 10, 2026, 4/5: "It's been good. Except today, it has started showing me ads with music! On my food journal entry log! Specifically Candy Crush ads with no option to mute them!!! PLEASE REMOVE ADS WITH SOUND. I DO NOT WANT BAD MUSIC BLASTING FOR EVERYONE TO HEAR WHILE I'M AT A CAFÉ ENTERING MY LUNCH!!!!!"

   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Sep 14, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
